official_definition: By either sending your 20px to the Trash, or putting a core from your "Heavenly Demon King" family Grandwalker Nexus to a Spirit you control, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Tenma Advent] or [Tenma Advent: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Tenma Advent]", "give [Tenma Advent]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
